spanish: Y el cinturón de su efodadura que sobre él, como su obra, desde él será: oro, azul y púrpura y carmesí y lino fino torcido.

findings.issue: Suffix on מִמֶּנּוּ is 1st common plural; «él» is 3rd masculine singular.
Common noun אֲפֻדָּה (fem. sg. + 3ms) is a coined transliteration «efodadura»; -adura is not licensed. «su» matches the suffix.
Construct תּוֹלַעַת (8438 b) + שָׁנִי is flattened to one color word, so the second token is not separate.
Unmarked article «el» is grammatical smoothing; the construct noun has no article token.

notes: Conjunctions, qal «será», hophal «torcido», and oro/azul/púrpura match their tokens.
